## Invitations

The outreach activity generated 6771 invitations for North City during the reporting period. A total of 5224 people attended, representing an attendance rate of 77.2 per cent. This indicates that most of those invited took part in the activity. The invitation process was used to support attendance and provide people with an opportunity to engage with the service.

Van days were maintained where road conditions allowed. This helped preserve outreach activity in areas that could be reached safely and supported continued access for invited people.

## Contact

Contact arrangements included text-message communication and reminder messages. SMS contact was used for 5721 invitations, providing information directly to those invited. A further 5721 people received a reminder message. These communications supported awareness of the invitation and helped reinforce the attendance arrangements.

The figures provide a summary of invitations issued, attendance recorded and contact activity completed during the period.

Prepared by G. Evans.
